description: Applies one fix, taken from a shoot_plan_check result, to a plan and checks the revised plan again. Some fixes trade one thing for another (each says its trade_off): tell your human before applying one that does. Input: plan; finding_id and fix_id (a finding's id, and the id of one of its suggestions, both from shoot_plan_check); and optionally findings, the check result you already have, which saves recomputing it. Output: {plan, findings}, the revised plan and its new findings. Nothing is stored, here or by us: keep the revised plan yourself. A wrong finding_id or fix_id is refused with the ids that exist. No AI model runs. Needs an agent key from a Shoot Plan account. Free, and it does not count toward the account's 3 free projects a month. Plans up to 8 MB and 120 calls a minute (5,000 a day).

finding_id.description: The id of a finding in the shoot_plan_check result, for example f-3a9c51d02b7e.

findings.description: Optional: the dpl.findings/1 document shoot_plan_check returned for this same plan, exactly as returned.

fix_id.description: The id of one of that finding's suggestions, for example fix-1 or restage.

plan.description: The plan itself: a dpl.plan/1 JSON object (not text inside a string). Call shoot_plan_format for the schema links and an example.

name: shoot_plan_apply_fix
title: Apply one tested fix to a shot plan
